home.heroTitle: Let your invitation be the first thing that impresses them
home.heroSubtitle: Design your wedding or event invitation in minutes: an elegant envelope that opens, music, a countdown, the evening’s agenda and one-tap RSVP — then share it with a single WhatsApp link.
home.heroPoint1: No app — it opens in the browser
home.heroPoint2: A private link for every guest, by name
home.stepsTitle: Three steps and your invitation is ready
home.step1Title: Pick a design and its colour
home.step1Body: Classic, romantic and modern designs — each in several ready colours to match your celebration.
home.step2Body: Names, both Hijri and Gregorian dates, the venue on the map and the evening’s agenda — in one clear form.
home.step3Body: Send each guest their own link over WhatsApp, and watch who accepted and who declined as it happens.
home.doorTitle: And on the night — how is the code scanned at the door?
home.doorSubtitle: Every guest carries their own QR code inside their invitation, and it is scanned straight from your door team's phone — no scanner hardware, no app, no account.
home.door1Body: From your event page, set a PIN (4 to 8 digits) and hand it to your door team along with the event's reference code.
home.door2Body: From the button at the top of the site, they enter the reference code and the PIN, and the scanner opens on their phone.
home.door3Title: Point the camera at the invitation
home.door3Body: As soon as the code is read, the guest's name and their remaining seats appear. Each scan counts one person in, so a guest and their party are scanned once each.
home.doorNote: Once a guest's seats are used up the scan returns "fully used", so nobody gets in on someone else's invitation. If the camera won't start, the code can be pasted in by hand. Door scanning is available on "with QR" invitations only.
home.guestTitle: Not an image you send — a moment they live
home.guestSubtitle: A paper invitation is opened once and forgotten. Yours stays on your guest’s phone: it reminds them, shows them the way, and collects their reply.
home.f1Body: The moment your guest opens the link, an elegant envelope opens in front of them — a first impression no image gives.
home.f2Body: A calm track suited to your occasion starts as the envelope opens, with a clear mute button always in reach.
home.f3Body: How long is left, in front of your guest every time they open it — with one-tap “add to calendar”.
home.f4Body: The hall’s name with a button that opens the map directly — no copying, no “where exactly is it?”.
home.f5Body: Attending or not, and how many are coming with them — it reaches your dashboard instantly.
home.f6Body: Reception, dinner, the ceremony — the whole evening inside the invitation, so nothing is missed.
home.templatesTitle: A design for every occasion, a colour for every design
home.pricingTitle: Pay for the invitations you send — nothing more
home.pricingSubtitle: No monthly subscription and no complicated bundles: a flat price per invitation, starting at 25.
home.pricingLink: Work out your cost by guest count
home.ctaTitle: An elegant envelope that opens on your guest’s phone
home.ctaBody: Choose your design, fill in your event details, and share it with your guests the same day.
home.ctaWhatsappMessage: Hi, I have a question about Dawati
home.footerTagline: Refined digital invitations for your occasions — designed in minutes, lived moment by moment.
home.faqNote: Didn’t find your answer? Message us on WhatsApp and we’ll get back to you quickly.
home.faq1Q: Does my guest need an app to open the invitation?
home.faq1A: No. It opens straight in the browser from the link you share on WhatsApp, on any phone.
home.faq2Q: How long does the invitation link stay live?
home.faq2A: The link doesn’t expire — your guests can open the invitation before the event and after it.
home.faq3Q: Can I edit the details after creating the event?
home.faq3A: Names, date and venue are fixed at creation because they appear on your guests’ invitations. Message us for any change and we’ll make it for you.
home.faq4Q: Can I add more invitations after buying?
home.faq4A: The count is set at purchase. If you need more, message us on WhatsApp and we’ll sort it out.
home.ctaStartFreeNote: Design it and see it before you pay — no account, no card.

Add the event to a phone calendar in one tap

typeface.sizeNote: Sizes and spacing are not set here: hand-coded designs keep them inside each design, and builder designs keep them per text layer. Font weight reaches builder designs only.
